channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Fernandez Hospital Hosts High-Impact CME on Advanced Minimally Invasive Gynaecological Surgery in Hyderabad
item.description: The intensive one-day academic programme saw participation from over 140 consultants, residents, fellows, and postgraduate students from across Telangana and neighbouring states, highlighting the growing demand for advanced training in minimally invasive gynaecological surgery.

item.title: Hyderabad to Host 12th Edition of Panacea 2026 – Natural Products Expo India from March 6
item.description: Organised by Seishido Communications with the support of the Telangana Biodiversity Board, Panacea 2026 marks its debut in Hyderabad, signalling the expo’s expansion into South India after building a strong presence across the Indian subcontinent over the past two decades.

item.title: School Bus Tragedy: 8-Year-Old Girl Dies After Falling Through Rusted Bus Floor
item.description: An 8-year-old girl died in a Uttar Pradesh school bus tragedy after falling through a rusted bus floor, raising serious concerns over school transport safety.

item.title: Key accused in attack on Lawrence Bishnoi’s lawyer arrested by Delhi Police
item.description: According to Delhi Police, late on the night of February 24, advocate Deepak Khatri was returning home from the temple with his team in a car when shooters linked to Rajasthan gangster Rohit Godhara opened fire.

item.title: Iranian drones strike US Embassy in Riyadh
item.description: The US Embassy in Riyadh was struck by two Iranian drones, causing a fire and resulting in material damage, Saudi Arabia's defence ministry said early on Tuesday, as the Middle East crisis entered its fourth day.

item.title: America will win, Iran defeated: White House to GOP lawmakers
item.description: The White House told Republican lawmakers on that “America will win” and that “the terrorist Iranian regime will be defeated,” as it defended President Donald Trump’s decision to launch major combat operations against Iran under “Operation Epic Fury.”

item.title: US urges Americans to leave Middle East, activates 24/7 task force
item.description: Assistant Secretary for Consular Affairs Mora Namdar said the State Department “urges Americans to DEPART NOW from the countries below using available commercial transportation, due to serious safety risks.”

item.title: Governors, CMs of Telugu states greet people on Holi
item.description: Holi stands for a rainbow of love, affection, happiness and also a symbol of peace and brotherhood, the Chief Minister said in his message. He appealed to people to celebrate the festival by using natural colours in a traditional way.

item.title: Dy CM Shinde arranges two special aircraft for stranded Maha citizens in Dubai
item.description: Amid the escalating tensions between Iran, Israel, and the United States, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde on Tuesday arranged two special aircraft to rescue citizens stranded in the UAE.

item.title: Indian firms making clean energy investments will reach better markets globally: PM Modi
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday said that as global supply chains are being reshaped, Indian companies who are making clean and green energy investments will be able to reach better markets worldwide.
